designation_texts: E1 centred potential read (s4 A7/P-iv): the matter reads the Lorenz ACCUMULATOR Phi, which has no matter source by design (the charge reaches Phi only through the exact current -> A -> D_t Phi = -div A); a lattice transpose (Phi sourced by the on-site density) would break the exact Lorenz C == 0 (s4 A6). Unavoidable in E1; reciprocal in the continuum (Newton III via CF-1).

E1 on-site alpha.A (and the div A part of the centred potential): its lattice transpose (an on-site current) is NOT the exactly conserved current; the conserved current of on-site-coupled matter is the A-free link hopping current (s4 A4). The literal transpose of that current (linear Peierls) adds a rank-4 diamagnetic current and loses exact continuity/Gauss (s4 D4: 57,718/58,000); no finite rank closes. Unavoidable in E1; reciprocal in the continuum.

E1 source = the EXACT free hopping current of the matter (s4 A4): exact continuity, Lorenz and dressed Gauss. Its literal partner (Peierls action) breaks them (D4). It is the continuum transpose of the on-site alpha.A action; Newton III needs only a species-independent source/action ratio (CF-1).
Lorenz ACCUMULATOR (first-order-in-time relation D_t Phi = -div A, rounding-free, s4 A6): Phi is slaved to A; a reciprocal partner would add grad Phi to the A wave equation and leave Lorenz gauge.
